vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tyrone, Luis, Noemi and Chloe met them at the door — 4 put down. Tyrone, Luis, Noemi, Chloe are hurt.
🛡️ Luis, Chloe and Stan met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Luis, Stan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tyrone just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tyrone, Luis, Noemi, Chloe and Rosa met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Tyrone, Luis, Chloe, Rosa are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Nevermore falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Nevermore!
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tyrone just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tyrone, Luis, Rosa, Dmitri and Ava met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Tyrone, Dmitri are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Elder Hummice 1 (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Elder Hummice 3 falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Hummice 3!
Chloe strikes the Elder Hummice 4.
The Elder Hummice 4 falls.
Chloe harries the Elder Hummice 1.
Elder Hummice 2 lashes at sand-ghosts near you. Missed. (pocket_sand)
The Elder Hummice 1 falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Hummice 1!
Chloe strikes the Elder Hummice 2.
The Elder Hummice 2 falls.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Terms of Service (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Pack-leader The Terms of Service lashes at sand-ghosts near you. Missed. (pocket_sand)
Tyrone strikes the Pack-leader The Terms of Service.
The Pack-leader The Terms of Service falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Terms of Service!
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Iryna was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Rosa showed Leo the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Iryna: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Leo and Mateo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Leo, Mateo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
